post.title: Why One More Scroll Never Feels Like Enough #shorts
post.description: Dopamine isn't the enemy: it helps your brain learn what's worth pursuing. Uncertain rewards, like checking for something interesting, can keep you coming back. Start small: mute nonessential alerts, put the phone out of reach, and choose one thing you meant to do. #psychology #shorts #dopamine #habits
